kanzlei.lead: Whether you are starting up, need ongoing bookkeeping or your annual accounts: you have dedicated contacts who know your business and keep an eye on deadlines, figures and opportunities.

leistungen.heading: Tax advice for *every stage* of your business
leistungen.lead: From founding to ongoing bookkeeping to annual accounts, for businesses and private clients alike. We take care of the obligations and keep track of the deadlines.

items.title: Tax advice
items.text: Tax returns for businesses and private clients, carefully prepared and filed on time. We check your tax assessments and represent you before the tax office.
items.alt: Tax advisor going through documents with a client

items.title: Bookkeeping
items.text: Ongoing bookkeeping with DATEV, digitally or the classic way with a document folder. You get reliable figures every month.
items.alt: Accountant working with reports on two monitors

items.title: Payroll
items.text: Payslips for your team on time, including all filings with health insurers, the tax office and the employers' liability insurance.
items.alt: Payroll specialist going through payslips with a business owner

items.title: Annual accounts
items.text: Balance sheet or cash-basis accounts, prepared on time and explained clearly. In the closing meeting we look ahead together.
points: Balance sheet and profit and loss statement

items.title: Business advice
items.text: Founding, choice of legal form, financing or succession: we calculate your options and support you in putting them into practice.
items.alt: Advisory meeting closing with a handshake

testimonials.heading: What our clients *say* about us
testimonials.lead: Businesses, self-employed professionals and private clients from {city} and the region. Since {founded}.

items.quote: We used to have two providers for bookkeeping and payroll and constant back-and-forth between them. Now everything runs through one place, and I get my monthly report on the 10th, not whenever.
Switching firms mid-year, I expected chaos. The handover was handled entirely by the firm, I only had to sign.
Finally someone who explains the numbers instead of just sending them. The quarterly meetings are now a fixed date for me.

faq.heading: Answers to what clients *ask*
faq.contactText: The first meeting is free and without obligation. We listen to your situation and tell you honestly whether we are a good fit.

items.a: Tax advisors in Germany charge according to the official fee regulation (StBVV). For ongoing services such as bookkeeping and payroll we can agree a monthly flat fee. Either way, we tell you the cost up front and put it in writing.
For businesses of every legal form, freelancers, self-employed professionals and private clients. Our focus is on small and mid-sized, owner-managed companies.
You give notice to your current firm, we take care of the rest: data transfer from DATEV, coordinating open deadlines and handing over documents. Switching is possible mid-year, too.

items.q: Do I need to change my accounting software?
items.a: In most cases, no. We work with DATEV and connect common programs and bank accounts. If a change makes sense, we will tell you and support the switch.

items.q: Do you also work with clients outside {city}?
items.a: Yes. Thanks to digital collaboration we support clients all over Germany. Personal meetings take place at our office in {city} or by video.

items.q: What do I need for the first meeting?
items.a: Nothing but a little time. Helpful are your last annual accounts or monthly report, or for private clients your last tax assessment.

news.heading: Tax topics that *matter* for your business
news.lead: In brief: what is changing, who it affects and what you should do now.

items.title: E-invoicing: what businesses need to know now
items.text: Since 2025, businesses in Germany must be able to receive e-invoices. Transition periods apply for sending. What you need to change, and by when.
items.alt: Master craftsman checking an invoice on his laptop in his workshop office

items.title: GmbH or UG: the numbers behind the decision
items.text: Share capital, liability, running costs and perception. We calculate both options using a concrete example.
items.alt: Two founders comparing documents and figures

cta.heading: Good advice starts with a *conversation*
cta.text: We clarify where you stand, what you need and what our support costs. Then you decide in your own time.
